questions.question: Full-stack development refers to proficiency in which of the following?
Full-stack developers have the skills to work on which layers of a web application?
options: All layers, from the user interface to server-side logic and database management
questions.correctAnswer: All layers, from the user interface to server-side logic and database management

questions.question: Which set of technologies are front-end technologies that full-stack developers should know?
Which of the following is a server-side programming language a full-stack developer may use?
Which of the following is a database a full-stack developer works with?
Full-stack developers are proficient in which version control system?
Full-stack developers can create and consume what to enable communication between different software systems?
Which skill allows a full-stack developer to debug issues across the entire web application stack?

options: Independently or with specialized front-end and back-end developers
questions.correctAnswer: Independently or with specialized front-end and back-end developers

questions.question: Full-stack developers are capable of handling the entire development process from which point to which point?
options: Only from styling to image optimization
Only from database design to server maintenance
Designing interfaces to implementing server-side logic
questions.correctAnswer: Designing interfaces to implementing server-side logic

questions.question: Which of the following best describes a full-stack developer?
options: A specialist who only manages databases
A designer who only creates visual mockups
A developer versatile in both client-side and server-side development
An administrator who only configures web servers
questions.correctAnswer: A developer versatile in both client-side and server-side development

questions.question: Which of the following is a database-related skill of a full-stack developer?
options: Compressing image files for faster loading
Handling keyboard events in the browser
Writing complex queries and optimizing data retrieval and storage
questions.correctAnswer: Writing complex queries and optimizing data retrieval and storage
